title: Untitled Project [-02:-20 - -01:-22]
lyrics:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum, dark synth drone]
[closed hi-hat on offbeats]

[Main Section]
[acid synth sequence enters with high resonance]
[distorted snare on beats 2 and 4]
[filter cutoff modulation on synth]

[Breakdown]
[kick drum drops out]
[white noise riser]
[glitchy percussion hits]

[Outro]
[kick drum returns]
[synth sequence fades out]
[final kick hit with long reverb tail]
